name: dj-josep-webpage-monousuario
description: Aplicación web monousuario para DJ Josep - Full Stack

scripts.build: pnpm run build:frontend && pnpm run build:backend
scripts.install:all: pnpm install && cd backend && pnpm install && cd ../frontend && pnpm install
scripts.clean: rm -rf node_modules backend/node_modules frontend/node_modules pnpm-lock.yaml backend/pnpm-lock.yaml frontend/pnpm-lock.yaml
scripts.setup: pnpm run install:all && cd backend && pnpm exec prisma generate && pnpm exec prisma db push && pnpm exec prisma db seed
scripts.db:reset: cd backend && pnpm exec prisma db push --force-reset && pnpm exec prisma db seed
scripts.test: echo "No hay tests configurados aún" && exit 0

author: DJ Josep
